title: eulophia welwitschii subsp. aurantiaca
intro: Eulophia welwitschii subsp. aurantiaca, commonly known as the Yellow-flowered Eulophia, is a species of orchid native to tropical Africa. This plant is prized for its medicinal properties and is used to treat a variety of health issues, including fever, rheumatism, and respiratory problems, due to its antipyretic, anti-inflammatory, and expectorant properties. The bioactive constituents of the plant, including flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, contribute to its therapeutic actions, which include reducing fever, alleviating pain, and loosening mucus. The health benefits of Eulophia welwitschii subsp. aurantiaca are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce oxidative stress, and exhibit antimicrobial activities.
